page.layout: One page of text. Top: continuation of the previous paragraph, full width. Below: an ornamental rule, then a centred three-line title. Then the body in paragraphs, full width. The left strip with fragments belongs to the neighbouring page and is left out. Signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: censetur puniri iustè, nisi quia id vel
non omittere, vel non committere potuisse
test quæ sit natura impotentiæ quæ
nisi à Deo efficacissimè vocentur, est ta-
per se credant, manifestum est partim
Cur id nunquam vel contingat vel con-
tingere queat, necesse est causam esse
Causa autem illa est vel in eo quod
homines ad eam rem facultatem habent
omnino nullam, vel in eo quod etsi fa-
cultatem aliquam ad eam rem habent,

page.notes: The ornamental rule under the running text is a typographic ornament, not text, and is not transcribed. The Greek phrase in the title is set small and was read with uncertainty in its accents and breathings; marked [?]. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. The left strip with fragments (af-, nà, to, o-, de, ta, &, us, etc.) is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. No running head is printed. No marginal notes in the text block.
